description: The behavioral spec REQ-BILL-029 covers CORS headers for billing responses (Allow-Credentials + Allow-Origin) and mentions OPTIONS preflight. However, no REQ specifies WHICH HTTP methods, headers, and max-age should be returned in the preflight response. The OPTIONS preflight for POST /v1/subscriptions must at minimum allow Content-Type header and POST method. Without explicit preflight response requirements, an implementer may return incomplete preflight headers causing browser CORS failures. Additionally, there is no REQ specifying Access-Control-Allow-Headers or Access-Control-Allow-Methods for the preflight response.

evidence.snippet: Responses to OPTIONS preflight also include correct CORS headers

sourceReference.snippet: Cookie連携API（session/subscriptions/cancel）は FRONTEND_BASE_URL のみを許可Originに固定し、Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true を必須とする

remediation: Expand REQ-BILL-029 to specify the complete CORS preflight response: Access-Control-Allow-Methods (POST), Access-Control-Allow-Headers (Content-Type, Cookie or similar), Access-Control-Allow-Credentials (true), Access-Control-Allow-Origin (FRONTEND_BASE_URL). Add acceptance criteria for the OPTIONS preflight path explicitly.
